subject.title: Control UI Dashboard v2 freezes on Chrome 146 (works fine in Firefox)

question: Should the fix path require a fresh current-main Chromium reproduction and targeted render-trigger removal, or should OpenClaw add an explicit safe/fallback Control UI mode for affected Chromium builds?
rationale: The current code has partial mitigations and a changed shell, but no live evidence proves the Chrome freeze is fixed or identifies whether fallback UX is warranted.

options.title: Reproduce then target the trigger
options.body: Use live Chromium diagnostics on current main, then remove or simplify the verified render/layout trigger without adding a new fallback mode unless the repro demands it.

options.title: Add a safe UI fallback
options.body: Accept a visible fallback mode for affected Chromium builds and define when operators should see or enable it.

options.title: Request fresh reporter evidence first
options.body: Keep the issue open but wait for current-version browser logs or a recording before prioritizing implementation.

recommendation.title: Reproduce then target the trigger
recommendation.body: Use live Chromium diagnostics on current main, then remove or simplify the verified render/layout trigger without adding a new fallback mode unless the repro demands it.

likelyOwner.reason: The Dashboard v2 and responsive-refresh history makes BunsDev the strongest routing candidate for the Control UI fix-shape decision.
